name: WebGUI Presentation
purpose: define stable domain-neutral presentation semantics for generic WebGUI primitives and structural composition without owning visual styling

semantics.data-state: generic component or presentation state carrier when the owning primitive defines such states
semantics.data-variant: presentation variant carrier when a dedicated structural class is unnecessary
semantics.native disabled state: authoritative disabled semantics for native controls
semantics.data-disabled: presentation carrier for disabled semantics on non-native composite structures only

rules: native controls use their native disabled semantics instead of CSS-only disabled state
data-disabled must not replace the native disabled attribute on native controls
state attributes represent generic UI semantics only and must not encode host-domain business meaning
this contract does not make visual state an application or authorization authority

WebGUI: generic primitive and structural composition semantics represented by .wg-*
generic state carrier semantics listed by this contract
Style: layout, spacing, color, typography and other visual properties

rules: WebGUI presentation semantics must not depend on WebEngine or any host application
Style may consume .wg-* and semantic state attributes but must not redefine their meaning
WebGUI must not encode visual appearance into .wg-* class names or state values
host applications may compose .wg-* primitives but must not redefine existing .wg-* semantics
domain-specific classes may coexist outside WebGUI but shared Style must not depend on domain meaning
presentation visibility or state is never authorization authority
generic WebGUI runtime helpers that are not listed here are not automatically part of the shared .wg-* presentation contract
implementationNote: Current WebGUI runtime still emits data-ui markers for several helpers. Runtime emission of the canonical .wg-* classes is an implementation alignment task and is intentionally not changed by this contract-only step.
